title: Mycobacterium chelonae infections of intravascular prostheses - an observational study
summary: Since 2022, several infections with the bacterium Mycobacterium chelonae have been detected in patients with prostheses of one manufacturer that had been implanted in blood vessels (mainly heart valves). Diagnosis of these infections is challenging and it is unclear how these infections should be optimally treated. The aim of this registry is to record infection and treatment courses.
conditions: Mycobacterium chelonae infection of intravascular prostheses
